summary: Single-choice dropdown: a button that opens a listbox of violet-option children. Use when the user picks one of a fixed list.

usage.text: The value attribute is the value of the selected option. The trigger shows that option's label, else the placeholder, else "Select an option". Selection is single only.
It opens from the trigger (click, Enter, Space, arrow keys), from the reflected open attribute, or from show() and hide(). No event reports opening or closing.
Choosing an option fires an input event then a change event, each with detail.value. Calling selectValue(value) fires them too; assigning the value property does not.
Typing a character on the closed trigger selects the next option whose label starts with it, firing a change event without opening.

a11y.text: The trigger is named by the label plus the shown value. Without a label its name is only the value or placeholder text.
